context: ▶ Corollary 14. The reduction system of Definition 12 has the Church-Rosser property (i.e. is confluent). ⌟ This follows abstractly from strong termination and uniqueness of normal forms. We conjecture that (local) confluence can also be established directly, in the following form: For all P , if Q1 ← P → Q2 then there exists an R and lists of reductions of length at most 2 with Q1 →∗ R ∗← Q2 . As an aside, note that we can apply the reduction rule (4) not just to incremental lists but also to arbitrary lists of natural numbers N∗ . This extended rewriting system is still strongly terminating, but no longer confluent.
